verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Jekọp vwo nyo nẹ ọka Ijipt, ọ da ta kẹ emọ rọye, Die ovwan ohwohwo vwo nẹ ohwo?
verses.text_romanized: oke ri jekop vwo nyo ne oka ijipt o da ta ke emo roye die ovwan ohwohwo vwo ne ohwo

verses.text_urhobo: O da ta, Nighe, mi nyori nẹ ọka Ijipt, yanran wa ra dẹ ọka kẹ avwanre vwẹ oboyi, rere ma vwọ rhọ, re e je ghwo.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta nighe mi nyori ne oka ijipt yanran wa ra de oka ke avwanre vwe oboyi rere ma vwo rho re e je ghwo

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ihwe rẹ emesẹ ri Josẹf da yanran kpo Ijipt ra dẹ oka.
verses.text_romanized: koye ihwe re emese ri josef da yanran kpo ijipt ra de oka

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp gbi ji Bẹnjamin rẹ oniọvo ri Josẹf nene aye-en, fiki rẹ oshọ rẹ emu de rhe ruo.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo jekop gbi ji benjamin re oniovo ri josef nene aye en fiki re osho re emu de rhe ruo

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹnẹ emọ rẹ Izrẹl yanran ra dẹ kugbe ihwo efa re je rhe dẹ, kidie owẹvwe na firi vwẹ otọ ri Kenan ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: kene emo re izrel yanran ra de kugbe ihwo efa re je rhe de kidie owevwe na firi vwe oto ri kenan ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana Josẹf kọye osun rẹ otọ na ejobi; ọye je ohwo rọ shẹ kẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na ejobi. Emesẹ ri Josẹf na da rhe, ayen de diguẹ bọvwọ epharo rhu otọ vwọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana josef koye osun re oto na ejobi oye je ohwo ro she ke ihwo re oto na ejobi emese ri josef na da rhe ayen de digue bovwo epharo rhu oto vwo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da mrẹ emesẹ rọye na, o de vughe ayen, ẹkẹvuọvo o de ru ayen kiri erhorha ọ da ta ota gbaegbae kẹ ayen. Tivọ we nurhe? ọ da ta. Ayen da ta, Nẹ otọ ri Kenan rhe, re de emu.
verses.text_romanized: josef da mre emese roye na o de vughe ayen ekevuovo o de ru ayen kiri erhorha o da ta ota gbaegbae ke ayen tivo we nurhe o da ta ayen da ta ne oto ri kenan rhe re de emu

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹnẹ Josẹf vughe emesẹ rọye, ẹkẹvuọvo jẹn ayen vughire-e.
verses.text_romanized: kene josef vughe emese roye ekevuovo jen ayen vughire e

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da karohọ evwerhẹ rọ vwerhẹ kpahe ayen, ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ovwan ogborhugborho, wa rhere re mrẹ ẹba rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: josef da karoho evwerhe ro vwerhe kpahe ayen o da ta ke ayen ovwan ogborhugborho wa rhere re mre eba re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta kẹ, Ẹjo, ọrovwovwe, ẹkẹvuọvo e mu ọye idibo wẹn rhe dẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ke ejo orovwovwe ekevuovo e mu oye idibo wen rhe de

verses.text_urhobo: Avwanre ejobi emọ rẹ ọshare ọvo, avwanre ihwo dẹdẹn, idibo wẹn dia igborhugborho-o.
verses.text_romanized: avwanre ejobi emo re oshare ovo avwanre ihwo deden idibo wen dia igborhugborho o

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ẹjo, ẹba rẹ otọ na ọye ovwan rhe mrẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen ejo eba re oto na oye ovwan rhe mre

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta, Avwanre, idibo wẹn, emesẹ ihwivẹ, emọ rẹ ọshare ọvo vwẹ otọ ri Kenan; gbe no, ọrẹ otete ejobi ọ vẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre obo uwevwi nonẹ na, ọro chekọ gbe herọ-ọ.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta avwanre idibo wen emese ihwive emo re oshare ovo vwe oto ri kenan gbe no ore otete ejobi o ve ose re avwanre obo uwevwi none na oro cheko gbe hero o

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen, O pha kirobo re Me ta kẹ ovwan na, ovwan ogborhugborho.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo josef da ta ke ayen o pha kirobo re me ta ke ovwan na ovwan ogborhugborho

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ Ọnana kọye Me vwọ davwe ovwan ni: vwẹ ogangan ri Fero, ovwan che kpo nẹ etinẹ-ẹ jokpa nẹ ovwan reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan rẹ otete ejobi na rhe etinẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe onana koye me vwo davwe ovwan ni vwe ogangan ri fero ovwan che kpo ne etine e jokpa ne ovwan reyo omoni re ovwan re otete ejobi na rhe etine

verses.text_urhobo: We ji ohwo ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ ovwan, rere ọ ra reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan na rhe, jẹn ovwan ri chekọ uwodi, kọna e vwo vughe uyota rẹ ovwan, sẹ ovwan ghine ihwo uyota, ọ rha dia ọtiọye-e, vwẹ ogangan ri Fero, o muẹro nẹ ogborhugborho ovwan ruẹ.
verses.text_romanized: we ji ohwo ovo vwe usun re ovwan rere o ra reyo omoni re ovwan na rhe jen ovwan ri cheko uwodi kona e vwo vughe uyota re ovwan se ovwan ghine ihwo uyota o rha dia otioye e vwe ogangan ri fero o muero ne ogborhugborho ovwan rue

verses.text_urhobo: O de mu ayen phihọ uwodi ẹdẹ erha.
verses.text_romanized: o de mu ayen phiho uwodi ede erha

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen, Ru Ọnana re ovwan rhọ, kidie Me djẹ oshọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ:
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede re erha josef da ta ke ayen ru onana re ovwan rho kidie me dje osho re oghene

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da dianẹ ovwan ghine ihwo rẹ uyota, we gbe jẹn ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ imoni rẹ ovwan na vwo vwẹ uwodi na, rere iri chekọ kpo re ayen ghwa eka rhe ekru rẹ ovwan rẹ owẹvwe hwe vwẹ obo uwevwi,
verses.text_romanized: o da diane ovwan ghine ihwo re uyota we gbe jen ovo vwe usun re imoni re ovwan na vwo vwe uwodi na rere iri cheko kpo re ayen ghwa eka rhe ekru re ovwan re owevwe hwe vwe obo uwevwi

verses.text_urhobo: re wa reyọ oniọvo rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na rhe vwe; kọye ota rẹ ovwan vwo muẹro, we gbi rhe ghwu-u. Ayen de ru ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: re wa reyo oniovo re ovwan re otete na rhe vwe koye ota re ovwan vwo muero we gbi rhe ghwu u ayen de ru otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da ta kẹ ohwohwo, Vwẹ ọrẹ uyota, avwanre riabe rẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ avwanre na, kidie avwanre mrẹ uvwerhe rẹ udu rọye, ọke rọ vwọ rẹ, avwanre kerhọ-ọ, fiki rẹ ọtiọye na ihri rẹ eku rọ viẹre na kọye a na mie avwanre na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da ta ke ohwohwo vwe ore uyota avwanre riabe re omose re avwanre na kidie avwanre mre uvwerhe re udu roye oke ro vwo re avwanre kerho o fiki re otioye na ihri re eku ro viere na koye a na mie avwanre na

verses.text_urhobo: Rubẹn da kpahe kẹ ayen, Me ta kẹ ovwan dẹrhẹye nu we ruẹ umwemwu kpahe ọmọ na-a? Ẹkẹvuọvo wa davwerhọ-ọ. Etinẹ na ihri rẹ ọbara rọye kọye a ria mie avwanre na.
verses.text_romanized: ruben da kpahe ke ayen me ta ke ovwan derheye nu we rue umwemwu kpahe omo na a ekevuovo wa davwerho o etine na ihri re obara roye koye a ria mie avwanre na

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen rha riẹn ni Josẹf nyo obo rẹ ayen ta na-a, kidie tanumeta uvwre rayen.
verses.text_romanized: ayen rha rien ni josef nyo obo re ayen ta na a kidie tanumeta uvwre rayen

verses.text_urhobo: O de chuko ku ayen ọ da viẹ, ro vwo rhivwi rhe ọ da ta ota kẹ ayen. Ọ da reyọ Simiọn ọ da gba vwẹ irharo rayen.
verses.text_romanized: o de chuko ku ayen o da vie ro vwo rhivwi rhe o da ta ota ke ayen o da reyo simion o da gba vwe irharo rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ emọ nẹ a ghwẹ eka vọ ebo rayen, re ji kru igho rayen phihọ ebo kẹ ayen, ra je vwẹ emu kẹ ayen re ayen re vwẹ idjerhe. E de ru Ọnana kẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke emo ne a ghwe eka vo ebo rayen re ji kru igho rayen phiho ebo ke ayen ra je vwe emu ke ayen re ayen re vwe idjerhe e de ru onana ke ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen de kru eghwa rẹ eka nyẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rayen, ayen da yanran.
verses.text_romanized: ayen de kru eghwa re eka nye eketekete rayen ayen da yanran

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọvo vwọ rhan unu rẹ ebo rọye re ọ vwẹ emu kẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rọye vwẹ asan re de muerhọ, ọ da mrẹ igho rọye vwẹ unu rẹ ebo rọye.
verses.text_romanized: re ovo vwo rhan unu re ebo roye re o vwe emu ke eketekete roye vwe asan re de muerho o da mre igho roye vwe unu re ebo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, A rhoma kru igho mẹ phihọ unu rẹ ebo mẹ. Rẹ ayen vwo nyo Ọnana, ọfiavwe da fiavwe ayen, ayen ke phariẹ kẹ ohwohwo, tanẹ, Ọna kidie Ọghẹnẹ rhi ru kẹ avwanre na?
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke emese roye a rhoma kru igho me phiho unu re ebo me re ayen vwo nyo onana ofiavwe da fiavwe ayen ayen ke pharie ke ohwohwo tane ona kidie oghene rhi ru ke avwanre na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi ra vwa ọsẹ rayen Jekọp vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, ayen de gbe ikun rẹ obo re phia kẹ ayen ejobi kẹ, tanẹ,
verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi ra vwa ose rayen jekop vwe oto ri kenan ayen de gbe ikun re obo re phia ke ayen ejobi ke tane

verses.text_urhobo: Ohwo na, ọrovwori rẹ otọ na, ọ ta ota gbaegbae vwọ kẹ avwanre, ọ da vwẹ avwanre roro igborhugborho re rhe mrẹ ẹba rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: ohwo na orovwori re oto na o ta ota gbaegbae vwo ke avwanre o da vwe avwanre roro igborhugborho re rhe mre eba re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo avwanre da ta kẹ, Avwanre ihwo rẹ uyota, avwanre dia igborhugborho-o;
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo avwanre da ta ke avwanre ihwo re uyota avwanre dia igborhugborho o

verses.text_urhobo: avwanre emesẹ ihwivẹ, emọ rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre, ọvo gbe herọ-ọ ọrẹ otete vẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre obo otọ ri Kenan nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: avwanre emese ihwive emo re ose re avwanre ovo gbe hero o ore otete ve ose re avwanre obo oto ri kenan none na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ohwo na, ọrovwori rẹ otọ na, da ta kẹ avwanre, Ọnana kọye Me vwọ riẹn nẹ ovwan omamọ rẹ ihwo rẹ uyota; wan yan jẹn ọvo rẹ emesẹ rẹ ovwan na vwo kẹ vwẹ, re wa reyọ eka rhe ekru rẹ ovwan rẹ owẹvwe hwe, re wa yanran.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ohwo na orovwori re oto na da ta ke avwanre onana koye me vwo rien ne ovwan omamo re ihwo re uyota wan yan jen ovo re emese re ovwan na vwo ke vwe re wa reyo eka rhe ekru re ovwan re owevwe hwe re wa yanran

verses.text_urhobo: Reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na rhe vwe, ke Me mrẹ vughe nẹ ovwan dia igborhugborho ẹkẹvuọvo ihwo rẹ uyota we ruẹ, ki mi siobọ nẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan, ku wa cho eki vwẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: reyo omoni re ovwan re otete na rhe vwe ke me mre vughe ne ovwan dia igborhugborho ekevuovo ihwo re uyota we rue ki mi siobo ne omose re ovwan ku wa cho eki vwe oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ayen vwo ku eghwa nẹ ebo na, nighe dohwo dọko rẹ igho rọye evun rẹ ebo rọye, te ayen te ọsẹ rayen vwọ mrẹ ọko rẹ igho rayen o de gbe ayen unu.
verses.text_romanized: re ayen vwo ku eghwa ne ebo na nighe dohwo doko re igho roye evun re ebo roye te ayen te ose rayen vwo mre oko re igho rayen o de gbe ayen unu

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp rẹ ọsẹ rayen da ta kẹ ayen, We rhe mie vwe emọ mẹ hwere: Josẹf gbe herọ-ọ, Simiọn gbe herọ-ọ, ovwan nẹ wa jẹn reyọ Bẹnjamin; enana ejobi kẹ omẹvwẹ emiavwa na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop re ose rayen da ta ke ayen we rhe mie vwe emo me hwere josef gbe hero o simion gbe hero o ovwan ne wa jen reyo benjamin enana ejobi ke omevwe emiavwa na

verses.text_urhobo: Rubẹn da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Hwe emọ mẹ ivẹ suọ ọ da dianẹ Me gbe sa reyọ rhe we-e; phio phihọ obọ mẹ, ki mi vwo rhe we.
verses.text_romanized: ruben da ta ke ose roye hwe emo me ive suo o da diane me gbe sa reyo rhe we e phio phiho obo me ki mi vwo rhe we

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta, Ọmọ mẹ che nene ovwan ra-a, kidie oniọvo rọye ghwuru, kẹ ọye ọvo ri chekọ. Emu de ruo vwẹ oyan rẹ ovwan cha ra na, ku wa reyọ ovwẹ vẹ esha vẹ uvweri rhi kpo ushi.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta omo me che nene ovwan ra a kidie oniovo roye ghwuru ke oye ovo ri cheko emu de ruo vwe oyan re ovwan cha ra na ku wa reyo ovwe ve esha ve uvweri rhi kpo ushi

headings.text_urhobo: Iniọvo ri Josẹf rhe Ijipt rhe de ọka
headings.text_romanized: iniovo ri josef rhe ijipt rhe de oka

headings.text_urhobo: Iniọvo ri Josẹf Rhivwi kpo Kenan
headings.text_romanized: iniovo ri josef rhivwi kpo kenan
